sampling_envelope.owner_CPU_semantics: Observed cooperative process-CPU budget checked by hash/guard operations and metadata watchdog; not an inherited low RLIMIT_CPU that would prevent children installing the6h hard cap.
sampling_envelope.resource_semantics: RLIMIT_AS is an independently enforced per-process virtual-address cap. The sum is not a claim of measured RSS. Owner and known live workers report their own positive peak RSS; missing/stale/invalid live-worker evidence stops admission and draining is requested. The aggregate3GiB RSS screen remains an observed planning rule, not a kernel quota.

scope_of_no_other_writer: No other dispatcher may write the original or new umbrella campaign. This does not forbid separately budgeted water/P256 jobs.

storage_revision.watchdog_action: Signal only this owner to stop admissions and bounded-drain owned children before reaching the reserved floor. It reads filesystem free bytes and only owned-worker RSS, never another project or process.
